title: UBP经济学家：美联储若删除“额外”一词，或暗示加息
speaker: Carlos Casanova

segments.en: We are in the middle of this week here. We got through what it comes to the Bank of Japan. As expected, it did high rates to 1% yesterday.
segments.zh: 本周已过半。日本央行如预期加息至1%。

segments.en: It was a whole from the RBA also expected. We're at the hump day, and really it is Fed day here today, and this is really going to be the big one.
segments.zh: 澳洲联储也如预期。周三关键日，今日美联储决议才是重头戏。

segments.en: Ahead, of course, the BOE, the SP, we got the eye coming up here as well, so certainly there's going to be a lot.
segments.zh: 接下来还有英国央行、标普等，事件密集。

segments.en: The key thing to watch though, I think, is to look at some of the statements there from the last one to see, and the word today of the day is additional, right?
segments.zh: 关键看上次声明中的措辞，今日关键词是“额外”。

segments.en: This is what they wrote in the last meeting, and considerate the extent and timing of additional adjustments to the target range for the federal funds, right?
segments.zh: 上次会议他们写道：考虑额外调整联邦基金利率目标区间的幅度和时机。

segments.en: So, if they remove that word, I think that could be a quite telling sign of maybe more of a hawkish sort of tilt from the FOMC.
segments.zh: 若删除该词，将是FOMC转向鹰派的明显信号。
